name: Brando Benifei - Proposition de résolution de remplacement - Am 1
title: REPORT on the institutional aspects of the Report on the future of European Competitiveness (Draghi Report)
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on Mario Draghi's report on Europe's competitiveness. It says the EU needs to decide faster and more simply, use majority voting instead of national vetoes in key areas, and give Parliament a stronger role. It calls for completing the single market, a savings and investments union, a European defence union, better rules for artificial intelligence, and more money for joint investment. It also wants treaty changes to prepare the EU for new member countries.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its position and requests reforms.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the European Commission, and citizens in areas like defence, energy and investment.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends its requests to the Council, Commission and European Council for them to act on.
